findings.evidence: Mathlib already uses this more general affine level: `Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Affine/AddTorsor.lean:244` has `[NormedAddTorsor E P]`, `:250` defines `DilationEquiv.smulTorsor (c : P)`, and `:264` proves `DilationEquiv.smulTorsor_preimage_ball`; the PR signatures at `Ball.lean:29`, `:39`, and `:50` restrict the center to `x : E`.
findings.fix: State the preimage lemmas with `{P : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor E P] (x : P)` and map `fun y : E => c • y +ᵥ x`, then derive the current additive-group forms as special cases if needed for existing names.
findings.issue: `preimage_const_add_smul_ball_norm`, `preimage_const_add_smul_closedBall`, and `preimage_const_add_smul_sphere` are stated only for `x : E` and `fun y : E => x + c • y`, but the natural affine-ball API is over a normed add torsor with center `x : P`.

summary: The new affine preimage lemmas are one level too specialized: they force the ball center to live in the same normed additive group as the model vectors, while Mathlib already treats scalar dilation about a point in a normed torsor.
